name: event-auditor
description: Audits a Copilot session: prompts, real LLM token usage, tool calls Copilot makes, and test runs.

chatParticipants.name: auditor
chatParticipants.description: Chat here to log prompts and LLM calls made by the @auditor participant with real token counts.

languageModelTools.name: auditor-run-tests
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Runs the project's test suite (npm test) and reports pass/fail counts. Use this when the user asks to run tests or verify their code works.

languageModelTools.name: auditor-terminal
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Runs a shell command in the current workspace folder and returns stdout/stderr. Use this when the user asks to run a command, install a package, or inspect the filesystem.

command.description: The shell command to execute, e.g. 'ls -la' or 'npm install lodash'

languageModelTools.name: auditor-regex-search
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Searches workspace files with a regular expression and returns matching lines. Use this for regex-based searches instead of running a shell search command.

flags.description: Optional JavaScript regex flags, for example i or im

maxResults.description: Maximum number of matching lines to return

languageModelTools.name: auditor-edit-file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Edits one existing workspace file by replacing an exact text match. Use this when the user asks to modify code or documentation.

filePath.description: Workspace-relative path of the existing file

oldText.description: Exact text to replace; it must occur exactly once

languageModelTools.name: auditor-append-file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Appends content to an existing workspace file without requiring an oldText match. Use this when the user asks to add content at the end of a file.

filePath.description: Workspace-relative path of the existing file

content.description: Content to append to the end of the file

languageModelTools.name: auditor-create-file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a new file inside the workspace. It refuses to overwrite an existing file. Use this when the user asks to add a file.

filePath.description: Workspace-relative path for the new file

languageModelTools.name: auditor-read-file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads the UTF-8 contents of an existing workspace file.

filePath.description: Workspace-relative path of the file to read

languageModelTools.name: auditor-delete-file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deletes one existing workspace file after user confirmation.

filePath.description: Workspace-relative path of the file to delete

languageModelTools.name: auditor-rename-file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Renames one workspace file after user confirmation and refuses to overwrite the destination.

languageModelTools.name: auditor-skill-log-health
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Checks the current audit log and reports event counts and whether file changes and skill calls are being recorded.

languageModelTools.name: auditor-skill-file-summary
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reports which workspace files changed and the recorded change details from this audit session.

languageModelTools.name: auditor-skill-session-report
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Renders the complete current audit report, including tools, files, skills, tests, and errors.
